# Voice Kit (@workhub/voice-kit)

> A Palgu-sponsored ElevenLabs starter kit for the Voice of the Oasis hackathon (Dubai Silicon Oasis × ElevenLabs × Doers Summit). It is a TypeScript library that adds bilingual (English/Arabic) ElevenLabs voice agents, TTS, STT, music, phone and avatar to any app. The core needs only one environment variable: `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY`.

Coding agents: read `llms-full.txt` before writing code. It has install steps, every export with its signature, copy-paste recipes for Next.js, Express and Vite, and the ElevenLabs gotchas that cost hours if you hit them yourself.

## Docs
- [Full reference for coding agents](https://voice-of-the-oasis.palgu.ai/llms-full.txt): install, API, recipes, gotchas
- [Human docs](https://voice-of-the-oasis.palgu.ai/docs): the same content as a web page
- [README](https://github.com/alinaqi/elevenlabs-voice-kit#readme): overview, local run, deploy

## Install
- [Release tarball v0.1.1](https://github.com/alinaqi/elevenlabs-voice-kit/releases/download/v0.1.1/workhub-voice-kit-0.1.1.tgz): `npm i <this url> @elevenlabs/react`
- [Source](https://github.com/alinaqi/elevenlabs-voice-kit/tree/main/packages/voice-kit): `packages/voice-kit`

## Live examples
- [Demo app](https://voice-of-the-oasis.palgu.ai): agents for the 3 hackathon challenges, avatar, research, TTS, STT
- [Demo source](https://github.com/alinaqi/elevenlabs-voice-kit/tree/main/apps/demo): Next.js 16 App Router usage of every feature
- [Phone bridge source](https://github.com/alinaqi/elevenlabs-voice-kit/tree/main/apps/phone): Twilio ⇄ ElevenAgents with hold music; call +1 350 218 1012
- [Research API](https://voice-kit-research.vercel.app): `POST /research {"question"}` returns `{answer, sources, confidence, cached}`
